implications.says: the cup was on its shelf when the lamp was lit: it was taken after
implications.concludes: after the gate lamp was lit

implications.says: the cup was taken after the lamp was lit; by then Bell was in mid-river, and the ferry lay at the far bank all night: it was not Bell
it was taken from a locked vestry whose lock was never forced: by someone with a key
there are two keys, the vicar's and the sexton's, and the vicar's was in his own pocket: it was Amos
